abstract: BACKGROUND: We investigated the distinguishing pathological features of bilateral ovarian tumors using magnetic resonance (MR) imaging. METHODS: Eighty-six patients with bilateral ovarian tumors on MR imaging were evaluated. The pathological diagnosis was investigated, and the results were subjected to statistical analysis using Mann-Whitney U test, Fisher's exact test, Chi-squared test and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve to determine the features useful for the differentiation of distinct types of lesions. RESULTS: The diagnosis of bilateral ovarian tumors was confirmed in eighty-one patients and the majority of the lesions were further classified into serous carcinoma (n = 36), mature teratoma (n = 20) and metastasis (n = 12). We assessed the existence of factors useful for the MR imaging differentiation between metastasis and serous carcinoma or primary malignant ovarian tumors. Cancer antigen (CA) 125 serum level and maximum tumor diameter were significantly different between metastasis and serous carcinoma and similarly, between metastasis and primary malignant ovarian tumors. MR imaging morphology, ascites and peritoneal implants did not show any significant difference between the different types of lesions. CONCLUSION: Within our patient cohort, most bilateral ovarian tumor lesions were determined to be serous carcinoma, mature teratoma or metastasis. CA 125 serum level and maximum tumor diameter are useful markers for the differentiation between metastasis and serous carcinoma or primary malignant ovarian tumors.
abstract_ja: 背景：MR画像を用いて両側卵巣腫瘍の鑑別に有用な病理学的特徴を検討した。方法：MR画像で両側卵巣腫瘍を認めた86例を評価した。病理学的診断を検討し、結果をMann-WhitneyのU検定、Fisherの正確確率検定、カイ二乗検定およびROC曲線を用いて統計解析し、異なる病変型の鑑別に有用な特徴を決定した。結果：81例で両側卵巣腫瘍の診断が確定し、病変の大部分は漿液性癌(n=36)、成熟奇形腫(n=20)、転移(n=12)に分類された。転移と漿液性癌、または原発性悪性卵巣腫瘍との間でMR画像鑑別に有用な因子の有無を評価した。CA125血清値と最大腫瘍径は、転移と漿液性癌との間、および転移と原発性悪性卵巣腫瘍との間で有意に異なっていた。MR画像の形態、腹水、腹膜播種は、病変の種類間で有意な差を示さなかった。結論：当施設の患者集団では、両側卵巣腫瘍病変の大部分は漿液性癌、成熟奇形腫、または転移と判定された。CA125血清値と最大腫瘍径は、転移と漿液性癌または原発性悪性卵巣腫瘍を鑑別する有用なマーカーである。
